challenges.title: Build a Stock Price Checker
description: Build a secure stock price checking app using a public stock API.
User Story: I can check the current price of a stock by ticker symbol.
User Story: I can 'like' a stock. My IP address is anonymized (hashed) before being stored.
User Story: I can compare two stocks and see which has more likes.
Security requirements: implement Helmet.js security headers, rate limiting on API endpoints, and input sanitization for ticker symbols.
Remember to use Read-Search-Ask if you get stuck.

challenges.title: Build a Secure Real-Time Chat App
description: Build a real-time chat application with proper authentication and security measures.
User Story: I can register and log in with a username and password (properly hashed with bcrypt).
User Story: Messages are sent and received in real time using WebSockets.
User Story: Only authenticated users can send messages.
Security requirements: JWT or session-based auth, XSS-sanitized message output, CSRF protection, rate limiting on message sending (max 10 messages per minute).
Remember to use Read-Search-Ask if you get stuck.

challenges.title: Claim your Information Security Certification
description: Congratulations on completing the Information Security certification!
You have learned password hashing, XSS prevention, JWT authentication, rate limiting, and how to build secure applications.
